messages:
sara: Heads-up — planning an opt-in edge canary for EU low-latency routing (model-v2). Goal: 5% EU traffic, p95 <= 100ms, two-week bake. Need flag naming, telemetry gates, and fallback plan. Thoughts?

mike: +1. region-wide cohort first is simplest.

leila: some customers want per-tenant control. start region-wide, expose opt-in later.

james: Ops: pick low-traffic window first 24h (UTC early morning). reserve Dedicated quota so canary doesn't affect others.

anna: eng-runtime suggests flag `edge_eu_lowlat_v2`. fallback to model-v1. telemetry keys: latency.p95, errors.rate, quality.regressions.

mike: Gates: p95 < 100ms AND errors.rate < 0.5% AND quality.regressions <= 1% on eval set. health checks every 5m; fail -> rollback.

leila: legal: EU KMS requirement for keys if per-tenant opt-in later.

ops-bot: @james deploy window 2024-04-12 02:00 UTC. preflight: capacity check, canary quota, alert hooks.

sara: flag stub: {"flag":"edge_eu_lowlat_v2","cohorts":"canary:5%","fallback":"model-v1","telemetry":"latency.p95,errors.rate,quality.regressions"}

mike: also want A/B inside canary: 50% caching vs 50% no-cache to measure tokens vs latency.

james: SRE circuit-breaker: if p95 > 150ms for 10m OR errors.rate > 1% for 5m -> auto-rollback. who owns pager?

anna: eng-runtime will own alerts and auto-rollback; canary dashboard + regression diffs, Sev2 pager on trip.

leila: CS/docs will draft customer comms and support playbook for opt-in customers.

sara: checklist: finalize flag config by EOD; ops reserve quota; create dashboard + eval harness; draft comms. owners: mike(flag/metrics), anna(rollback/alerts), james(ops), leila(comms).

mike: ack. opening flag PR and unit tests for deterministic bucketing.

ops-bot: preflight passed. deploy scheduled 2024-04-12 02:00 UTC.

sara: thanks — closing. will post 24h and 7d signals after bake.
